context.dataset: Round2 V2 official tabular data, 21 instantaneous features
context.split: five-fold development on seeds 42 and 3407; no four-seed confirmation
context.target: tap_iron isolated replacement; original time strings retained
context.metric: isolated package score increment, higher is better
context.data_boundary: no official test targets or outer labels used in fitting; private artifacts under local/

hypothesis: Averaging three independently trained joint-PLR iron predictors reduces seed noise without changing the time component.
changed_factors: iron prediction: 0.5 V36 plus 0.5 mean of J42/J104729/J130363 instead of 0.5 V36 plus 0.5 J42
held_constant: released CSV row order and formatting

evidence.effect_metric: mean isolated package score points across two development seeds
evidence.limitations: Two development seeds only; does not meet original +0.01 mechanism gate or four-seed confirmation.

evidence.effect_metric: reported platform score points relative to V32 parent
evidence.limitations: No independent receipt; one package cannot estimate a general local-to-platform transfer factor.

decision.rationale: The user-reported platform score improved, but the frozen no-finalist decision and missing confirmation remain unchanged.
decision.reopen_condition: A prospectively registered new recipe or genuinely new data/validation evidence, not a retroactive gate waiver.
decision.next_check: Use 96.3749 as reported platform reference; do not automatically release any neighbor candidate.
